t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Different coloured gnomes correspond to a red or yellow basket. Each colour basket will give higher or lower mushrooms for a few rounds. When they swap, you need to swap gnomes accordingly.

vb_textbox.text: The different coloured gnomes relate to either yellow or red baskets. The coloured gnomes which relate to each basket do not change throughout the game. However the colour of baskets which contains the most mushrooms does change. When a basket begins showing a low number of mushrooms switch to the other one until that one also goes low, and then switch back. I do think that overall the yellow baskets performed better than the red baskets, probably 3 quarters of the time the yellow baskets seemed better.
